episodes.synopsis: To turn Beelac into an ancestral craftswoman and to get the futuristic toys in Inventoria up and running, Sunraku needs a magic control unit.
episodes.title: Half-Naked Birdman and the Gang in Golem Paradise

episodes.synopsis: Sunraku and his pals make it into the Divinity-era workshop and retrieve the magic operations unit, but Pencilgon and Oikatzo have a score to settle with him before the quest proceeds any further.
episodes.title: The Uncompromising Gatekeeper

episodes.synopsis: It's time for Sunraku to face the music as Pencilgon and Oikatzo force him to come face to face with the various factions he's been ignoring.
episodes.title: Accelerating Meetings, Surging Desire, and the Start of Various Threads

episodes.synopsis: Pencilgon makes a proposal to the other clans. Sunraku forwards his interests in Rabituza, and faces a setback in his farming of the Crystal Scorpions.
episodes.title: When Humanity Dreams of the Impossible and Takes to the Skies

episodes.synopsis: Sunraku's attempts to farm the Crystal Scorpions for money are complicated when a giant gold scorpion enters the fray.
episodes.title: The Impetus of Hunger; the Persistence of Thirst

episodes.synopsis: In the midst of his god-like run, Sunraku faces a setback that sours him on Shangri-La Frontier, but his sister has some advice to turn things around.
episodes.title: After the Fierce Battle, Despair

episodes.synopsis: In Nephilim Hollow, Rust is slavering for a rematch with Sunraku, but Sunraku himself isn't in top fighting form after three months away from the game.
episodes.title: The Wings in a Draw

episodes.synopsis: The battle of Crimson Twinewing vs. Fiddler Crab reaches its climax, and Sunraku decides what to do next.
episodes.title: The Lion Catches a Rabbit with Its Full Strength; the Crab Catches a Phoenix with a Pizza Cutter

episodes.synopsis: Back in Shangri-La Frontier, Sunraku needs to speed through the game to make his appointment with Mold and Rust. To make it in time, though, he'll have to ask a certain someone for aid.
episodes.title: Run, Fueled by Impatience

episodes.synopsis: Sunraku meets up with Psyger-0 to take on the Lightless Barrens, but can't get his head around his new companion's strange behavior.
episodes.title: Track It Like a Bloodhound

episodes.synopsis: SF-Zoo shows shocking resilience in the face of the strongest foe they've ever faced, and Sunraku, paired with Psyger-0, must decide how to approach the task.
episodes.title: Embrace the Lamplight of Ambition (1)

episodes.synopsis: Sunraku and Psyger-0 engage Lycagon the Nightslayer, but Sunraku realizes that the assumptions he's made about the Colossus's patterns may not necessarily hold up.
episodes.title: Embrace the Lamplight of Ambition (2)

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Sunraku, Psyger-0, and Lycagon continues! But just as the Colossus seems poised to dominate, a new ally joins the fray.
episodes.title: Embrace the Lamplight of Ambition (3)

episodes.synopsis: Psyger-0's Ultimate is almost ready for release, but first Rei must recite a long incantation. The rest of the team must cover Lycagon in the meantime, with Sunraku revealing the Gilta Brill's own ultimate attack as well.
episodes.title: Embrace the Lamplight of Ambition (4)

episodes.synopsis: Sunraku receives the consequences of his defeat of Lycagon's shade, and as the group moves on to Fifticia to meet with Rust and Mold, another new twist awaits him.
episodes.title: Embrace the Lamplight of Ambition (5)

episodes.synopsis: Katzo and Pencilgon reaffirm their motives moving forward, and the defeat of Lycagon's shade has repercussions for the devs.
episodes.title: What Do You Play Games For? Their Answers

episodes.synopsis: Sunraku gets an intriguing offer from Kei, then meets up with Rust and Mold to pursue the Ctarnidd quest.
episodes.title: A Straight Flush Mixed with Jokers

episodes.synopsis: Sunraku and his new crew set out on the high seas to confront Ctarnidd and the Disciples of the Abyss.
episodes.title: The Crimson Whale Meets the Monster Fish

episodes.synopsis: Sunraku and his new party fight on the ghost ship and unlock the next stage of the Ctarnidd quest: an underwater city!
episodes.title: Revive, Broken City, Your Peace at an End

episodes.synopsis: Sunraku's plan to reunite his party ends with him fighting an overpowered dragon eel.
episodes.title: Time to Fillet a Dragon Fish

episodes.synopsis: Sunraku joins his teammates at the GGC where he learns more about the favor Katzo needs.
episodes.title: Venturing Wolves Then from the Seas to the Skyscrapers

episodes.synopsis: The miraculous light bursts forth in glory for a moment.
episodes.title: The Light Blazes Brightly, But for Just an Instant

episodes.synopsis: Rakuro should be training for his tournament match, but finds himself succumbing to the call of SLF.
episodes.title: Malice at 100 Meters Per Second

episodes.synopsis: Sunraku's diversion back to SLF continues with a hair-raising battle against Atlanticus Lepnorca.
episodes.title: Great King of the Deep, I Humbly Seek to Crush You

episodes.synopsis: Nitro Squad prepares for the exhibition match, but disaster threatens Kei's rematch with Sylvia.
episodes.title: The Anonymous (Asinine) A-Team and a Crisis
